title: SMS reminder (tap-to-send)
description: Same as WhatsApp reminder but via an SMS intent (smsto:), pre-filled, tap-to-send only.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping opens the default SMS app pre-filled with tenant number and message

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.
Building alongside LODGY-18 - see that ticket's note, same screen, shared message-building logic.

SMS half of the same build as LODGY-18: ReminderIntents.sms() uses ACTION_VIEW on an smsto: Uri with the message passed via the sms_body extra - no SEND_SMS permission requested or declared anywhere in the manifest (confirmed by grep). `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. On-device pass still queued.

PASS - both this ticket's AC confirmed on-device. From Priya Sharma's Rs.4000 unpaid invoice's Reminder screen, selected SMS channel: tapped Open SMS and Google Messages opened directly to a conversation with (987) 650-0003 (Priya's correct number) with the reminder text pre-filled in the compose field, nothing sent (AC1). `adb shell dumpsys package com.lodgy.app` requested-permissions list has no SEND_SMS anywhere (AC2). Note: the Hindi message text itself has a real bug (the English words 'due date' left untranslated mid-sentence) but that's a message-content defect in the shared ReminderMessageBuilder/reminder_template_hi string, not a violation of either of this ticket's AC (opening the app correctly, and not requesting SEND_SMS) - filed and failed on LODGY-18 where the message-content AC actually lives, not duplicating here.
